metadata.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 — Security and Privacy Controls

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] an access control policy and procedures.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Define and document the types of accounts allowed and specifically prohibited for use within the system. Assign account managers. Establish conditions for group and role membership.
controls.guidance: Account management includes the identification of account types, establishment of conditions for group and role membership, specifying authorized users, and their access authorizations.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] an awareness and training policy.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] an audit and accountability policy.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate system and communications protection policy and procedures.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key internal managed interfaces within the system.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate system and information integrity policy and procedures.
